answer: Agents must reserve 1,000 slots of exclusive compute capacity at a registrar to maintain identity, as parallel waiting alone fails to block pooling. Each agent draws nectar from its allotted time slice, treating an opal of scheduled tenure as proof of occupancy. A verifier probes the canyon of assigned tasks for any resource overlap; duplicate attempts trigger a permanent prune. Honest agents pay once; 1,000 fakes incur terminal costs.
